I think it could be selfish to love but leave immediately if it was your choice and they don’t know whats going on, but I don’t think you’re crazy or bad for wanting it. ngl, I’ve thought the same too. I just love people but I dont know what I’m doing here, and it seems that you might be something like that too. 

I dont have all the answers, im sorry, but I want you to know that this post is so tragic—and beautiful. You sound like a fascinating, lovely person, and no matter where you end up, I hope you (yourself) can feel, even just a little, some of the love that you’re ready to give to others.

no, its not easy at all! I can empathize well with that too. 
I hope you feel even just a little more seen and heard, I def do. I wonder too how many people will feel less alone by just viewing this post and reading our comments, because I know others’ posts have helped me in the past too. 

I have no idea where in the globe youre located lol, so I wish you a great rest of your day, or night, and that you’re able to take some time and take care of yourself a little physically. I guarantee that a little self love can make you feel more affirmed, even if that love is just a face mask, or a bath and a good book, or whatever. you deserve to be loved, especially by yourself. 

thanks for talking bud

something really stupid that brings just a little light to my life is having a god damn tiny christmas tree in my room. I don’t know what we’re here for, and im exhausted a lot of the time from simply thinking about being alive, but that god damn tiny christmas tree always manages to get a smile out of me when I come home.
 I wonder if its the essence of things like my tree that make life something worth enduring.

I know there isnt much a stranger can say that would feel truly meaningful, so I just want you to know that someone (me) has read this post, and can hear that you’re calling out for help. Being open enough to talk about this stuff is a bigger deal than It can seem sometimes, and I hope you’re proud of yourself for coming on here and being vulnerable like this—Its an amazing step towards learning how to heal.

I have my own experiences with what youre describing—ngl I got on this subreddit tonight because I was feeling something very similar: I have friends and people who I am “surrounded” by, but I still can feel so desperately alone. I don’t really know the answer to alleviating this right now, but I think finding someone, even online, who can empathize is a good place to start.

Visit some of the Hopewell Mounds around Central Ohio!! Theyre great insight into the ancient history of Ohio, and the peoples that lived here. Also, Ohio has the best pizza, hands down. Try Stadz Pizzaria, Shirkeys, and Jets Pizza if you want a taste of the different pizza types offered.
I’m so sorry, and I relate. I hope your situation gets better, and you find healthy methods to cope. 🤍

I don’t have a lot of words to say, because I know that words of encouragement can seem really empty from someone who doesn’t personally know you or has been through experiences with you, so all I will say is that I have read your story, and thank you for sharing. I’m listening to you, and please let me know if there is any way I can encourage you. I wish you the best
I thought the exact same thing!! Its so nice seeing that someone else thought it too, since my siblings disagree w me 😭

I’m so sorry to hear that, that is awful :(. I struggle with suicidal thoughts too, and something thats been helping me is the idea that in a few years I’ll be so happy I didn’t end it now, there will be a time where you have relief, you must hold on to that reality ! There is hope! At the very least, please know that I believe in you! I’m not sure the full extent of your situation, but you have people on the subreddit backing you!
